$comment: Claude reviewer permissions, used by review.mjs --reviewer claude. Read-only, and launched with --permission-mode dontAsk, so anything not allowed here is refused rather than prompted: nobody is watching this run. The runner has already built and tested the branch, so no dotnet or npm. The rtk-prefixed git rules exist because the RTK PreToolUse hook rewrites `git x` to `rtk git x` before the permission check. Same model as the /build agent: a reviewer weaker than the author it audits cannot catch the mistakes the author was capable of making.
